_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_weight" INTEGER NULL, "last_message_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_read_at" INTEGER NULL, "message_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "models" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek' CHECK(provider IN ('deepseek', 'openai_compatible', 'local_reserved')), "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "api_base_url" TEXT NULL, "api_key_secure_key" TEXT NULL, "model_tag" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NULL, "capabilities" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_checked_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant', 'system')), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('sending', 'streaming', 'sent', 'failed', 'interrupted', 'deleted')), "error_code" TEXT NULL, "error_detail" TEXT NULL, "message_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK(message_kind IN ('normal', 'continuation', 'proactive', 'system_note')), "proactive_meta" TEXT NULL, "request_id" TEXT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES models (id), "token_prompt" INTEGER NULL, "token_completion" INTEGER NULL, "token_reasoning" INTEGER NULL, "cost_est" REAL NULL, "reasoning_content" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES messages (id), "owner_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_kind IN ('message', 'post', 'diary', 'letter', 'import')), "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "ocr_text" TEXT NULL, "ai_caption" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persona_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT NULL, "intro" TEXT NULL, "core_system_prompt" TEXT NULL, "active_version_id" TEXT NULL, "interests" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persona_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "layer" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(layer IN ('core', 'growth', 'samples')), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "change_reason" TEXT NULL, "confirmed_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'init' CHECK(confirmed_by IN ('user', 'migration', 'init')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persona_growth_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persona_versions (id), "growth_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_value" TEXT NULL, "after_value" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_experience_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK(status IN ('proposed', 'confirmed', 'reverted')), "confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expression_samples" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "context_note" TEXT NULL, "style_tags" TEXT NULL, "related_message_id" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'active', 'stale', 'superseded', 'conflict', 'archived')), "title" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK(confidence IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), "importance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "aliases" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "evidence" TEXT NULL, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL, "source_message_ids" TEXT NULL, "supersedes" TEXT NULL, "superseded_by" TEXT NULL, "conflicts_with" TEXT NULL, "is_resident" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sensitivity" TEXT NULL, "recall_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_recalled_at" INTEGER NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_relations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id), "to_memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id), "relation_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_type IN ('related', 'supports', 'contradicts', 'caused_by')), "strength" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "discovered_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rule' CHECK(discovered_by IN ('rule', 'thinking', 'user')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "memory_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id), "version_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "before_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "after_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "change_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(change_kind IN ('create', 'update', 'merge', 'status', 'supersede')), "reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_candidates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposed_title" TEXT NULL, "proposed_summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposed_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "importance" INTEGER NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rule' CHECK(origin IN ('rule', 'llm', 'thinking', 'import')), "grounding_note" TEXT NULL, "scan_flags" TEXT NULL, "compare_result" TEXT NULL, "target_memory_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES memories (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'rejected', 'applied')), "refusable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thinking_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK(trigger IN ('foreground_timer', 'background_bgtask', 'app_resume', 'manual')), "bg_task_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created' CHECK(state IN ('created', 'loading', 'reviewing', 'analyzing', 'saving', 'deciding', 'done', 'failed', 'interrupted')), "checkpoint" TEXT NULL, "reviewed_until" INTEGER NULL, "scope_note" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "interrupted_at" INTEGER NULL, "result_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thinking_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES thinking_tasks (id), "result_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_message_ids" TEXT NULL, "confidence" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proactive_candidates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chat' CHECK(action_kind IN ('chat', 'post', 'diary', 'letter', 'review_experience', 'memory_housekeeping', 'quiet')), "title" TEXT NULL, "content_draft" TEXT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_experience_id" TEXT NULL, "related_task_id" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'queued', 'executing', 'executed', 'cancelled', 'expired', 'rejected')), "dedup_key" TEXT NULL, "cooldown_until" INTEGER NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proactive_actions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "candidate_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proactive_candidates (id), "action_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "executed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deliverable_type" TEXT NULL, "deliverable_id" TEXT NULL, "decision_note" TEXT NULL, "user_feedback_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'scheduled', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'expired')), "conversation_id" TEXT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NULL, "candidate_id" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "notification_id" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_timezone" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_experiences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_content" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_conversation_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "importance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "user_perspective" TEXT NULL, "bubble_perspective" TEXT NULL, "review_log" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "posts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "mood" TEXT NULL, "topic" TEXT NULL, "image_ids" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'autonomous' CHECK(origin IN ('autonomous', 'user_topic')), "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_conversation_id" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edited_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diaries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ai_organized' CHECK(origin IN ('ai_organized', 'manual')), "related_message_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "versions" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "letters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('bubble_to_user', 'user_to_bubble')), "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(state IN ('draft', 'sent')), "title" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_memory_ids" TEXT NULL, "related_experience_ids" TEXT NULL, "sent_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feedback_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "verdict" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verdict IN ('like', 'dislike', 'adjust', 'correct')), "note" TEXT NULL, "action_taken" TEXT NULL, "reverted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "model_usages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES models (id), "scene" TEXT NOT NULL, "token_prompt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "token_completion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cost_est" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "request_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "privacy_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'minimal' CHECK(privacy_mode IN ('full', 'minimal', 'hidden')), "allow_post_notify" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "allow_diary_letter_notify" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "daily_notify_cap" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "quiet_start" TEXT NULL, "quiet_end" TEXT NULL, "quiet_timezone" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_task_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_type" TEXT NULL, "event" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "next_submit_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'astrbot', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, "target_table" TEXT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'migrated' CHECK(status IN ('migrated', 'skipped', 'failed', 'verified')), "notes" TEXT NULL, "migrated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "table_counts" TEXT NULL, "db_schema_version" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "verified_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok' CHECK(status IN ('ok', 'corrupt')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_digest" TEXT NULL, "after_digest" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_index_terms" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("token", "doc_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_index_docs" ("doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "preview" TEXT NULL, "importance" INTEGER NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "checksum" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("doc_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_index_terms" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("token", "doc_kind", "doc_id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_conversations_list ON conversations (deleted_at, last_message_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_messages_status ON messages (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_kind_created ON messages (message_kind, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_request_id ON messages (request_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_owner ON attachments (owner_kind, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_sha ON attachments (sha256)
CREATE INDEX idx_persona_versions_active ON persona_versions (is_active)
CREATE INDEX idx_persona_versions_no ON persona_versions (version_no)
CREATE INDEX idx_growth_status ON persona_growth_records (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_growth_version ON persona_growth_records (version_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_expression_pinned ON expression_samples (pinned)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_status_type ON memories (status, type)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_pinned ON memories (pinned)
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_updated ON memories (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_relations_from ON memory_relations (from_memory_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_relations_to ON memory_relations (to_memory_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_memory_relations_triple ON memory_relations (from_memory_id, to_memory_id, relation_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_versions_mem ON memory_versions (memory_id, version_no)
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_candidates_status ON memory_candidates (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_thinking_state ON thinking_tasks (state)
CREATE INDEX idx_thinking_trigger_started ON thinking_tasks ("trigger", started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_thinking_results_task ON thinking_results (task_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_thinking_results_kind ON thinking_results (result_kind)
CREATE INDEX idx_proactive_candidates_status ON proactive_candidates (status, priority)
CREATE INDEX idx_proactive_candidates_dedup ON proactive_candidates (dedup_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_proactive_candidates_expires ON proactive_candidates (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_proactive_actions_executed ON proactive_actions (executed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_status_at ON scheduled_messages (status, scheduled_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_expires ON scheduled_messages (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_tz ON scheduled_messages (scheduled_timezone)
CREATE INDEX idx_experiences_occurred ON shared_experiences (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_posts_published ON posts (published_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_diaries_entry_date ON diaries (entry_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_letters_direction_state ON letters (direction, state, sent_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_target ON feedback_records (target_kind, target_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_model_usage_daily ON model_usages (model_id, scene, day)
CREATE INDEX idx_migration_source_ref ON migration_records (source_ref)
CREATE INDEX idx_migration_category_status ON migration_records (category, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_entity ON journal_logs (entity_table, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_journal_at ON journal_logs (at)
